result.summary: Found several visual issues: a critical untranslated content key, truncated restaurant names, and partial clipping of category filters and promo cards.

issues.description: Section heading shows raw localization key 'home_feed.popular_title' instead of human-readable text
issues.suggestion: Replace the key with the proper translated string (e.g. 'Popular near you') and ensure all i18n keys resolve correctly

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' is truncated/cut off in the Fastest near you carousel
issues.suggestion: Allow multi-line titles, reduce font size, or ensure cards have enough width so full names are visible

issues.description: Category filter chips row is clipped on the right; 'Healthy' and any further options are partially cut off with no clear scroll affordance
issues.suggestion: Add horizontal scroll with visible fade/peek of next chip, or wrap/adjust spacing so all primary filters are fully visible

issues.description: Bottom restaurant card (pizza) is partially cut off by the tab bar, hiding the full image and any title/details below
issues.suggestion: Add bottom content padding so cards clear the fixed tab bar, or ensure the scroll view insets account for the nav height

issues.description: Third card in 'Fastest near you' is only partially visible at the edge without a strong indication more content can be scrolled
issues.suggestion: Show a clearer peek of the next card and/or add a scroll indicator so users know the row is horizontally scrollable
